note: BH-8066. Seconds the gh PATH shim answers a repeat `gh api` GET from state/gh-cache/ with no request (bin/lib/gh-cache.sh). Past it the shim sends If-None-Match: a 304 keeps the entry, a 200 replaces it. It also bounds how stale an entry can be when no webhook wake names its object, and how long a box whose wakes read failed waits before it tries again. 0 turns the cache off. An env value wins; else the shim resolves it through lib_env_apply gh-ledger at most once per LANE_GATE_CACHE_S into state/gh-cache/.knobs; code fallback 60.
